azure-harness.name: azure-harness
azure-harness.prompt:
IMPLEMENT the disposable MEAS-004/005 Azure harness using the prerequisite runtime-drivers immutable result. Merge prerequisite result first; don't recreate/overwrite its work. User wants HA finished on local branch, no main merge; temporary measurement apps and cleanup authorized, no new dependencies. This worker implements/offline-tests only: never provision Azure or open PRs. Parent will run Azure.
Read pool-briefs/T30c-design.md (proposals, not evidence), prerequisite deploy/azure-container-apps/ha/measure-gateway-contract.md, existing measure.ps1/.test.ps1/.dockerfile/.md and pure templates.ps1. Deliver measure-gateway.ps1 + measure-gateway.test.ps1 plus image/dispatch support in existing measure files. Use the actual prerequisite CLI contract, not invented placeholders. Make end-to-end execution possible from clean pinned source with one command per MEAS-004 overhead/scale or MEAS-005 poll interval; expose bounded pilot duration/counts and record effective values. Preserve existing MEAS-007/002 behavior. Do NOT bypass HA deployment qualification verifier: independent disposable measurement path only.
New RG only, exact owner/run/expiry tags, refuse protected names vlite-app/vlite-env/vlite-data/asendme-rg and any preexisting/foreign resources. ACR Basic admin-disabled; managed identity and role-specific container-scoped grants, HTTPS-only Standard_ZRS storage with no shared keys/public access; isolated ACA environment. Actual gateway apps fixed2 for overhead/MEAS005; scale min2/max4 matched in runtime max. Trusted writer1 internal-only with private ephemeral fixture copied from image (restart invalidates trial); reader1 for MEAS005 if required by contract. No production files or account IDs in evidence. Existing ACA secrets only, private generation-suffixed manifests. Bootstrap fixture/authority/control before serving using contract; no repeated uncertain init. Same-environment manual jobs timeout<=3600 retry0. Verify syntax/JSON shapes in mocks; bounds all retries.
Collect concurrent 5s revision-scoped replica inventory while job runs, not after. Preserve raw verified gzip/base64/checksum driver output; separate derived evidence for scale reaction intervals and MEAS005 replica coverage/clock uncertainty. Unknown/missing/stale/partial outcomes are explicit, not zeros. Full per-replica convergence requires snapshot+floor and stable identities; unbounded cross-host clock means timing incomplete. Bounded logs/inventory, no credentials/native diagnostics/IDs. Always request group deletion in finally and await exit0+boolean false, retain separate measurement and cleanup failure; no KeepOnFailure for new modes. Test preexisting/foreign resources, redaction, malformed/unknown observations, checksum/schema/provenance, failure cleanup, replica changes and missing coverage. Don't weaken observation gates to force success.
Exclusive: deploy/azure-container-apps/ha/measure-gateway.ps1; measure-gateway.test.ps1; measure.ps1; measure.test.ps1; measure.dockerfile; measure.md; optional measure-gateway-entrypoint.py and its tests. Do not edit deploy.ps1/templates.ps1, PRD, Rust, base deployment files, site/dashboard. Run both new and existing mocked PowerShell suites, Docker build input checks, formatting/diff checks. If contract genuinely prevents execution, fix narrowly by reporting precise blocker rather than a success placeholder. Commit with Copilot App coauthor trailer and executable usage/smoke commands in result.

runtime-drivers.name: runtime-drivers
runtime-drivers.prompt:
Implement (not another design report) the Rust tooling for MEAS-004 gateway overhead/scale load and MEAS-005 control propagation. User: 'Finish the HA work in local branch don't merge in the main yet'; temporary isolated measurement apps with cleanup authorized; no new dependencies. Parent handles Azure. Read pool-briefs/T30c-design.md and existing benchmarks/ha_meas002.rs, tests/gateway_azurite.rs. The report is design guidance, not measured truth: choose the smallest runnable implementation preserving its safety/evidence boundaries. Stop after working code and validation, never use Azure or open PRs.
Deliver examples ha-meas004 and ha-meas005 (server feature), plus ONLY necessary opt-in vlite-server gateway-measure helper(s) for private signing/bootstrap. Implement a documented bounded machine-consumable CLI/config contract for a following PowerShell harness. Include fixture/bootstrap, real short-lived direct trusted envelopes without auth bypass, lifecycle cleanup/redaction, and a per-process observer if required. Do not invent endpoints/replica headers. Prefer whole-command commit brackets explicitly labeled command_bracket over invasive PUT instrumentation; report clock uncertainty/censoring honestly. MEAS-004 uses ABBA, monotonic open-loop bounded concurrency, no retries, all statuses/errors/unsent counted, semantic body checking. MEAS-005 uses actual generation AND verifier floor, revocation/suspension/resumption behavioral checks, seeded jitter, per-replica coverage (not ingress sampling pretending all replicas), bounded counts and successful-only nearest-rank distributions. If a capability cannot be measured, retain explicit incomplete/unknown, never fabricated zero/success. Include small configurable pilot durations/counts for smoke runs, and full proposed defaults. No qualification/deployment gates changed, no automatic failover, writer_only remains.
Use schemas vlite-meas004/1 and vlite-meas005/1 with qualification=proposal_evidence_only, source revision/dirty from existing provenance env, limits+requested settings+uncertainty. Success exactly one compact JSON stdout; secrets never in evidence/errors; failure nonzero. Add no deps or Cargo.lock changes. Document EXACT commands, bootstrap/config shapes and app/job entrypoint needs in deploy/azure-container-apps/ha/measure-gateway-contract.md so dependent harness can execute without guesses. This is executable interface documentation, not another planning brief.
Exclusive files: benchmarks/ha_meas004.rs, benchmarks/ha_meas005.rs, optional benchmarks/ha_gateway_support.rs; src/server/gateway_measure.rs; src/server.rs; src/bin/vlite-server.rs; minimal helper visibility in src/server/{gateway,gateway_mode,gateway_trust,principal_envelope,control_state}.rs; Cargo.toml; Dockerfile; bindings/{manylinux.Dockerfile,node/Dockerfile}; .dockerignore; tests/gateway_measure.rs; tests/server_cli.rs; docs/API.md; site/api.html; above contract. Do NOT edit PRD, deployment scripts, dashboard or other files. Update Docker COPY allowlists for examples. Run focused unit/parser/CLI regressions, fmt, clippy for affected targets, docker_build_inputs.py, api_reference.py site, Cargo.lock unchanged. Use loopback Azurite only if available; state exactly validation run and limitations. Commit with Copilot App coauthor trailer.
